summary: Aptorum Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching Pre-Effective Amendment No. 4 to its proxy/prospectus on Form S-4 related to a pending merger with DiamiR Biosciences Corp. under a July 14, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger. The filing updates financial statements and disclosures for the all-stock reverse merger, where Aptorum acquires DiamiR. No specific terms (price per share, premium) are disclosed in this excerpt. The transaction requires Aptorum shareholder approval and other closings. This is a routine update on an ongoing merger, not a new special-situation trigger; the deal was announced previously.
